images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: concept approval image for a pixel-art game scene, NOT a finished sprite pack.
Input image 1 is the Sakura coast STYLE AND LEVEL BROADSIDE CAMERA reference. Input image 2 is the Ship deck STYLE AND CREW SCALE reference, a sprite sheet; do not reproduce the sheet.
Create ONE full scene by DAY, 3:2 landscape, composed on a 480x320 logical pixel grid, presented at 3x nearest-neighbour (1440x960). Crisp square pixels, controlled low-colour clusters and stepped shading, no painterly softness, no high-resolution microdetail. Match the references' warm wooden outlines and small readable sailors. Whimsical storybook sky-pirates, gently magical, a little brass, not gritty industrial steampunk.
The ship is strictly LEVEL SIDE-ON BROADSIDE: bow LEFT, raised stern RIGHT, long horizontal deck and horizontal keel; just enough view down onto the deck to see paths as in the references, NEVER a diagonal three-quarter hull. Entire ship and balloon within frame.
One wooden pirate ship slung under a large horizontal patched cream balloon, muted sage and coral patches, warm brass bands. Balloon occupies logical x105..370 y45..140; accessible tiny lookout basket ON TOP with a sailor, rope ladder along near face down to deck. Two short cream side sails extend from near ends, neither hides the deck. Suspended hull spans x65..405 y205..260. Brass four-blade stern propeller at right, vapour trailing right. Left bowsprit with little carved bird figurehead and blocked sailor. Wheel and waiting sailor on raised right stern; a visible small brass crank engine and glowing firebox amidships with two working sailors. Deck hatch at left-of-centre with arriving sailor half up ladder. Round gondola windows below deck show small sleeping sailors in hammocks, three or four windows. Four amber rail lanterns. Short departure plank projects left from lower bow area toward a clear cloud landing pocket.
A sea of soft layered CLOUDS, not water, fills lower frame below hull. Bright blue sky, warm late-morning light, pink-gold horizon remnants, distant floating grass islands and mountain peaks above clouds. Two tiny birds and a tiny distant airship. Small friendly slate-blue sky whale with cream throat is HALF-SUNK in lower-left cloud bank: only domed forehead, eye, top of back and a fin emerge; cloud wisps visibly OCCLUDE belly and lower silhouette, no gap below it. Tiny blank speech bubble with three dots above whale, distinct from ship. Reserve clear space for future crew badges. No words, title, labels, decorative border or UI. This is one coherent charming readable game scene.

Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: second concept approval image, NIGHT version of the exact attached sky-pirate airship scene.
The attached image is the EDIT TARGET and definitive design reference. Preserve identical framing, level horizontal broadside camera, hull outline, balloon shape and patch positions, lookout atop balloon, rope ladder, two stubby side sails, four suspension ropes, wheel and raised stern on right, brass engine amidships, left hatch, bird figurehead, left plank, four round hammock windows, lanterns and right propeller. Preserve each sailor's position, the small whale's location half submerged in foreground clouds, and the floating islands/mountain silhouettes. Same 3:2 landscape composition, intended 480x320 logical game stage, crisp square pixel clusters like the source, small readable sailors, no smooth painted rendering.
Change ONLY time and lighting to a magical deep-blue NIGHT. Large pale moon in the open upper-right sky BEHIND the distant mountain, stars sprinkled in open sky, indigo and lavender cloud sea with cool silver upper edges. Balloon cream becomes subdued moonlit blue-cream; sage and coral patches remain identifiable. Warm amber lanterns, hammock portholes and central engine firebox glow clearly, warm pool on deck. Maintain visible dark wood detail, readable faces and ropes; not crushed blacks. The small slate-blue sky whale retains cream throat and kind eye, lower half concealed by overlapping cloud bank, mist at cloud line and tiny three-dot speech marker. Keep ship architecture and proportions unchanged. No title, words, new props or border.

Use case: lighting-weather plus precise-object-edit. Asset type: third concept approval image, STORM AND WHALE DEPARTURE in the exact attached sky-pirate airship scene.
Attached day concept is the EDIT TARGET and definitive design reference. Preserve the same 3:2 landscape framing, pixel-art style, LEVEL BROADSIDE CAMERA, horizontal wooden hull, patched cream/sage/coral balloon, lookout basket ON TOP, ladder, suspension ropes, two stubby sails, engine amidships, left hatch, round hammock windows, lanterns, wheel on raised RIGHT stern and brass propeller. Do not tilt or turn the hull, do not change architecture, do not add a second ship foreground. Intended 480x320 logical game stage, clear small sailors and crisp stepped pixel clusters, not smooth digital painting.
Replace blue sky with a dramatic storm: dark violet charcoal thunderheads, racing cloud wisps, diagonal pixel rain streaks, a bright branching lightning bolt in the OPEN upper-left sky behind balloon, cool lightning rim light with warm amber deck lamps and firebox. Side sails strain, pennant streams right. Distant islands partly swallowed by fog. In far upper-right sky, a small sinuous turquoise SKY SERPENT coils through distant cloud wisps as the peak-storm creature, subordinate to foreground action, does not cross or obscure ship.
Show the exact moment of the departure: the sailor formerly on the LEFT plank is now falling feet-first just BELOW the plank's outer end, directly into the wide upward-facing mouth of a LARGE friendly slate-blue sky whale rising out of the lower-left cloud sea. The sailor is small, identifiable navy outfit and white hat; lower legs already disappear into the mouth, upper body visible with comical surprised raised arms. Whale has cream pleated throat, rounded forehead and benign eye, NO pointed shark teeth, no blood, whimsical swallow. Its tail and lower body remain buried in clouds; a circular CLOUD PUFF erupts around it, clearly fluffy cloud, NOT liquid water or spray. Maintain visible plank-to-sailor-to-mouth spatial connection and leave hull/windows visible. Replace the small suggestion whale in this shot with this larger departure whale so the action is unambiguous; no speech marker on eater. All other crew remain at their stations. No text, no labels, no borders.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fourth concept approval image, CLOSE-UP of the small suggestion whale in the attached sky-airship design.
Attached image is the definitive DESIGN/STYLE reference. Create a magnified detail of its LOWER LEFT suggestion whale and surrounding cloud bank, with only a cropped section of the SAME level wooden airship gondola high in the background (same dark-blue straps, warm wood, brass-rimmed hammock windows and amber lantern). Not a different ship, no alternative design. Landscape 3:2.
Hero is a small friendly slate-blue SKY WHALE with rounded forehead, tiny kind dark eye, cream pleated throat, rounded flippers, matching the reference whale. It faces right. The whale is HALF-SUNK INSIDE a continuous CLOUD BANK, NOT floating above clouds. The cloud surface visibly crosses the middle of its body, foreground opaque cream/lavender puffs overlap the belly, lower flank and tail base; only its domed back, forehead, eye, upper cream cheek and one small fin clearly emerge. The buried underside is only faintly suggested through blue mist, with no complete lower outline and NO open-air gap below the whale. Broad scalloped pale mist wisps cross in front at the cloud line, two thin pale pixel arcs read as swirling mist rather than water ripples. No water.
A tiny white pixel speech marker containing exactly three dark square dots floats in clear space immediately above the whale, separated from its back. It is a friendly clickable suggestion companion, not the large departure eater: mouth CLOSED, no falling sailor. Warm daylight, pale pink-gold cloud highlights, cool periwinkle shadows, quiet distant floating island. Preserve the cozy crisp pixel-art style with strongly readable clusters; enlarge logical pixel clusters to make the surface overlap obvious, do not add high-resolution texture or photoreal shading. This is a close-up from an intended 480x320 game scene; future carrier target about 56-64 logical pixels wide, not a giant foreground monster. No captions, labels, border or other UI.
